reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
We must stand together against this bigotry and hate in all its forms. 

To those in the Indian-American community: I stand with you amid a dangerous rise in anti-Indian sentiment in the US. I’ll keep working to make our community safe for everyone.

https://t.co/Leg7GFPY2H

The U.S. has lost its measles elimination status as cases continue to rise and RFK Jr. spews vaccine misinformation.

Vaccines are safe, effective, and lifesaving. https://t.co/9VkQiQ4o7O

@RepNewhouse stopped by my office this week to deliver WSU’s mascot, Butch T. Cougar!

Thank you for your dedication to our state and your service, Dan, you will be missed. https://t.co/TfjmI76F4c

The U.S. just lost its measles elimination status. Measles is on the rise because of RFK Jr.’s misinformation campaign, which has scared parents and botched the measles outbreak response. Now, the nation that has always led the world in medicine is reversing course. 

As a
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/bz7dNrGB4E

I am grateful to Congressman McDermott for his lifetime of service to our state and our nation, and send heartfelt condolences to his family and loved ones.

https://t.co/lk1oFQxP0V
Vaccines and routine care like vitamin K are safe and effective. RFK Jr: By continuing to spew misinformation, you are actively putting newborns in danger. https://t.co/6sv4VSsSvQ

We must always uphold our commitment to Veterans.

For too long, Veterans injured in combat have been denied full benefits. I am proud that today, the Major Richard Star Act passed the House. This legislation allows all medically retired Veterans to receive their full retired pay and disability compensation, a long-overdue change that will support Veterans in Washington state and across the country.

Now and always, we will continue our work to expand services to the brave men and women who have served our nation.

https://t.co/9qS4KtXhf1

This is heartbreaking, and a direct result of RFK Jr.’s “Spillover Effect” as his vaccine conspiracy theories create widespread distrust.

RFK Jr.’s claims about standard care like vitamin K have deadly consequences, and parents are left confused as this administration touts conflicting messages and rolls back decades of scientific public health guidelines.

Parents: Talk to your doctor about what is best for you and your family.

https://t.co/8AbChjOgIp

Today we honor the courage and dedication of our Veterans.

We must ensure that Veterans and their families receive the care, benefits, and opportunities they deserve. 

It is an honor to represent Veterans from Washington’s Eighth District in Congress: Thank you today and every https://t.co/2xPnpYmMui
It’s time for Congress to get to work for everyday Americans. https://t.co/XOApnLQYh1
Happy Diwali to those who celebrate in #WA08! Wishing everyone a bright holiday shared with you and your loved ones. https://t.co/axKCT9Xj3B
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/TwgqCMJpLV

I’m ready to hold this administration accountable and fight for #WA08. It is time to:

- Lower healthcare costs
- Eliminate corruption
- Bring down gas, grocery, housing prices
- Restore Forest Service staff
- Regulate AI and social media

Let's get to work.

Today is Election Day! 

If you haven't voted yet, make your plan to cast your ballot. Visit https://t.co/GQbWh40yTl to find a nearby ballot box and learn more about voting in Washington state. https://t.co/MDfnMBUlbI

Local students and recent graduates: My Issaquah and DC offices are accepting applications for our winter/spring 2027 internship program!

Get your applications in by this Wednesday, November 4th, here: https://t.co/1eeB3FIzlk
It was great to meet with Black Diamond Mayor Adler recently to chat about city updates and plans for the winter season. https://t.co/z8N6hAS6R5
The Eatonville Family Agency does amazing work for our families and seniors in need. Thanks for showing me around and for serving our community! https://t.co/hli8vL8oHy
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/xlwfDlEfcD

I will continue my work in Congress to secure funding for the Eighth District and pass laws that improve healthcare, Veteran services, nutrition programs, support for farmers, and more!

https://t.co/NQgevdWMM2 https://t.co/hSZBF8zEnK

Thanks to Eatonville School District leaders for advocating for our students, teachers, and families! 

It was great to talk about plans for the school year and ways I can support local education initiatives in Congress. https://t.co/3SN0VEAWpD

#WA08: It’s time to make your voices heard! Election day is one week away.

Visit https://t.co/GQbWh40yTl to find a nearby ballot box and learn more about voting in our state.

The Enchantments need to be protected.

I will continue my work with state leaders to improve conditions, and urge the Trump Administration to reverse Forest Service cuts that have threatened our environment, visitor safety, and local economies. https://t.co/Tgc3v5HJIW

Reminder for Eighth District students: If you would like to apply to a service academy, my office is accepting applications for military academy nominations.

The deadline to apply is October 31st. To learn more, please follow the link below!

https://t.co/bkltGkfqc6

Medical research saves lives. 

I met with scientists at the @fredhutch Cancer Center this week to thank them for their work and to discuss the importance of restoring federal health research funding. https://t.co/w2aOM96giL
It was great to stop by Pink Moon Farm recently, a local farm in Eatonville dedicated to sustainable farming practices. Thanks for showing me around! https://t.co/fTfrDgECDM
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/LdXULYViw5

Farmers, Tribes, and local communities across our region rely on wetlands and the species they protect.

I am proud to introduce my bipartisan NW VIP Act to support habitat restoration and the management of invasive species across the Pacific Northwest.

https://t.co/BwhMYl6pYc https://t.co/m76oAo4lAQ

It was great to tour DeGoede Farms yesterday to talk about their partnership with @goodrootsnw to deliver fresh food for Washingtonians in need!

Thank you for feeding and supporting our communities. https://t.co/4kuGALFSMO

Medicine that people need to survive should never be unaffordable or out of reach. As a doctor and someone with Type 1 diabetes, I know that costs are too high.

I am proud to have introduced my Insulin Act to cap the price of insulin at $35, and will continue my work to bring down healthcare costs across the board.

Global health research prevents diseases, stops pandemics, and saves lives. 

I visited PATH’s headquarters today to talk about their medical research and humanitarian work abroad. Thank you for the tour! https://t.co/mLGUa3UOrb

I was grateful to meet with Veterans and Our Valley Our Future leaders in Wenatchee to discuss how important it is to expand access to mental health and healthcare resources for Veterans in Washington state.

Thank you for advocating for Vets here and across the country. https://t.co/XgwUjgPe8e
I met with great kiddos and teachers, including a former patient of mine, at Snoqualmie Elementary School last week! Thanks for having me and showing me around. https://t.co/EsGqqKeT3h

Senator @PattyMurray and I met with firefighters and leadership from the WA State Fire Training Academy in North Bend to tour the facility and thank them for protecting our communities from wildfires.

In Congress, I’ll keep supporting our firefighters, bolstering local response https://t.co/sJzrqEmOVg

Thanks to everyone at University House Issaquah who chatted with me this week about the importance of protecting Social Security, expanding healthcare coverage, lowering prices, and other important issues. https://t.co/clpZpd3cej

Our small businesses need support as they face skyrocketing prices and an uncertain market.

Thank you to the business owners who joined me and the Sammamish Chamber of Commerce this week to discuss the issues you are facing and how I can help in Congress. https://t.co/5a91QPgRWC
It was great to meet owners Ryan and Ellen at Steel Wheel Farm in Fall City this week and talk about their sustainable practices and produce. Thank you for having me! https://t.co/Aaygq1EkeM
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/C67I6BqYkX

I am heartbroken by yesterday’s shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. I am thinking of the victims, their families, the brave first responders, and our neighbors in Oregon.

As we continue to mourn, we must recommit ourselves to ending gun violence and preventing future tragedies like this from happening.

Medicare Open Enrollment starts today! From now through December 7, you can review your Medicare coverage and make changes to your health or prescription drug plan for 2027.

Learn more here: https://t.co/fmAtiXswve

RFK Jr.'s anti-vaccine conspiracy theories are now hindering our response to avian flu, putting our food supply in jeopardy, threatening flock populations, and potentially risking another human pandemic. 

Farmers are desperate for a vaccine to protect their flock, and nobody wants another spike in egg prices. RFK Jr: Follow the science, not the conspiracy theories.

https://t.co/vaWdDovcww

Touring HopeSource’s new affordable housing units for Veterans in Ellensburg was one of the highlights of my district visits last week. 

I was proud to secure funding for this new housing for senior Veterans, and I look forward to watching the Pathways Project grow!

https://t.co/PHEvlH2jrp

This Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor the histories, cultures, and traditions of Tribal communities in #WA08 and across the country. 

Today we thank these communities and recognize their incredible impact. https://t.co/my39SxvRsG

Resource centers and food banks are critical for communities across #WA08 and the country.

This week, I toured the Auburn Resource Center to learn how I can support their work providing Auburn with food, mental health, childcare, Veteran, housing, healthcare, and employment support.

Calling local students: My Issaquah and DC offices are currently accepting applications for our winter/spring 2027 internship!

The deadline to apply is November 4th, and the link to submit your application is below: https://t.co/1eeB3FIzlk

Thanks to the seniors at the Upper Kittitas County Senior Center who chatted with me this week. 

It was great to hear from you all about what’s been on your minds, and to join a birthday celebration! https://t.co/CPoDL7dq2Z
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/rwBrMEHccw

Traffic backups and accidents on I-90 between Easton and Cle Elum have been dangerous for Washingtonians, and increased congestion has even impacted wildfire and emergency responses.

I am proud to have secured funding to widen this portion of I-90 to make the area safer for our communities.
Another wonderful Pioneer Coffee stop in Cle Elum on my way to meet with constituents! https://t.co/FsZtrBQozl
A fantastic week so far in the district! https://t.co/pLFhttbsWu

As our country experiences the largest measles outbreak in 35 years, the Trump Administration is instead focused on dismantling vaccine guidelines and delaying access to childhood immunizations.

That’s why I joined @SenatorBennet to demand the CDC reverse these dangerous decisions to save lives.

https://t.co/UzXk0TrLna

Three years ago today, Hamas terrorists launched a horrific, unprovoked attack on Israel, torturing and killing over 1,200 innocent people and kidnapping hundreds of hostages.

Today, we remember the lives lost and reaffirm our commitment to working to establish two states for two peoples with leaders committed to enduring peace and dignity for both Israelis and Palestinians.

Today I spoke with King County Flood Control District staff to check in about preparation for the winter season and flood risk reduction. 

Thanks for helping us all recover and stay safe as the rainy season begins! https://t.co/KD51wLcCzK

Last month, Forest Service officers coordinated with ICE to arrest five men camping with their families in the Mount Baker-Snoqualmie Forest area.

This is a misuse of taxpayer dollars and USFS resources – especially as wildfire relief and recovery efforts continue across our state. I joined my colleagues today to demand transparency from the Trump Administration.

https://t.co/4r0JlU0gIo

A reminder that my office can help you access federal benefits and connect with a federal agency!

Please call my Issaquah office at (425) 657-1001 if you need assistance. https://t.co/YBeCTw0SDi

I had the best time announcing the winner for this year’s Capitol Hill Pet Contest! Thank you, @AnimalsHealthy, for having me and for advocating for the health of our pets and animals.

Congrats to Riley, Jax, and Fried Rice! https://t.co/UMlAHPNiWi
Here is this week’s Schrier Flyer! https://t.co/XQyXgwLs0C

Today my office hit an exciting milestone: So far this Congress, we have returned over $7 million in federal benefits back to constituents in #WA08!

If you need help accessing tax returns, VA benefits, Social Security, or need any other federal agency help – give my office a call.

I had a great meeting recently with members of the @ilwulongshore to talk about how to support workers in Washington state and boost local economies across the country. Thanks for stopping by! https://t.co/dFNe9BywgW

I joined @PattyMurray, alongside the entire Washington delegation, in urging President Trump to approve Individual Assistance to help WA families recover after a devastating wildfire season.

I will continue my work to help our communities across #WA08 rebuild and repair.

https://t.co/cmlqhil7Jv

I am thrilled to announce that my Hydropower Licensing Transparency Act was recently signed into law!

This law will improve access to clean energy, lower costs, and enhance river health. Read more here: https://t.co/yUO7zavTcG https://t.co/qMLLvWX7cu

post.text:
We must always uphold our commitment to Veterans.

For too long, Veterans injured in combat have been denied full benefits. I am proud that today, the Major Richard Star Act passed the House. This legislation allows all medically retired Veterans to receive their full retired pay and disability compensation, a long-overdue change that will support Veterans in Washington state and across the country.

Now and always, we will continue our work to expand services to the brave men and women who have served our nation.

https://t.co/9qS4KtXhf1

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
